desc: Implement an O(n) sliding-window monotonic deque solution for `minMaxSubarraySum`: for each right endpoint, maintain an increasing deque of `(min_value, count)` groups and a decreasing deque of `(max_value, count)` groups over all active left endpoints with subarray length at most `k`, keep running sums of `value * count`, remove the oldest left endpoint when the active window exceeds `k`, and return the combined minimum and maximum totals.
Verify the current solution by running the provided examples, edge cases (k=1, k=n, all equal, negative values), and random brute-force comparisons; report any failures.
